sentences.en: Imogen of the Internet crochets about half of her possessions.
sentences.zh: 伊吉蒙在网上编织了她一半的所有物。

sentences.en: In today's world, possessions are plentiful, but time is scarce.
sentences.zh: 在当今世界，虽然拥有众多物品，但时间却十分稀缺。

sentences.en: Portugal has decriminalized the possession of drugs for personal use.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙已经将个人使用毒品的持有行为去罪化。

senses.zh: 占有, 持有, 拥有 - 个人财产, 私人财物 - 领地, 属地, 殖民地
